messages:
Anya K: Morning — saw another span gap event for service:search ~01:15 UTC for ~40m. Pattern matches prior incidents (ETL checkpoint drift + aggregator change). Need owners and short plan.

Mike L: Ill handle aggregator side. Will check last two deploys and revert if dedupe tweak looks causal.

Priya S: Deployed dedupe tweak at 00:50. Ill hold new promotions and provide deploy logs.

Jordan (Data Eng): ETL metrics show checkpoint commits missing on worker-3 around 01:08 (GC pause). Looks like shard-3 skipped writes. Will restart that worker and run targeted backfill.

Anya K: Plan: (1) Immediate rollback if aggregator change affects counts (owner Mike), (2) restart ETL worker + backfill (Jordan), (3) add short-term alerts and synthetic span producer (Jordan), (4) update runbook and schedule review (Elaine), (5) deploy gating automation (Priya).

Mike L: Opening INF-3522 for rollback + hotfix. ETA: rollback in 90m.

Jordan (Data Eng): Backfill started 02:30 UTC for shard-3. Estimated catch-up 18-36h. Added temporary alert: per_shard_span_drop > 25% for 15m -> page oncall.

Priya S: Will create INF-3523 for gating automation requiring canary span-rate within +/-5% for 15m before promote. ETA 5 business days.

Elaine: Runbook RB-4302 updated with "Span gap response" checklist and rollback steps. Scheduling a postmortem meeting for tomorrow with data-eng, infra, and product-analytics.

ops-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-171 created and linked to INF-3522, INF-3523, RB-4302. Pager notified.

Anya K: Owners confirmed: Mike=aggregator rollback, Jordan=ETL restart/backfill + monitoring, Priya=deploy gating, Elaine=runbook/review. Tag postmortem as recurring-pattern. Closure criteria: backfill complete, runbook published, gating live, and no missing_spans alerts for 14 days.

Mike L: Revert deployed; canary span counts returned to baseline.

Jordan (Data Eng): Monitoring additions pushed: dashboard /dash/spans-health; synthetic producer added to staging CI. Will post daily progress in #incidents-daily.

Anya K: Thanks. Mark items in postmortem doc with due dates and move to in-progress. We'll reconvene after backfill completes and after the review meeting.
